events.title: Why Is PVH (PVH) Up 18.9% Since Last Earnings Report?
events.body: PVH (PVH) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

events.title: PVH Insider Sells $642K in Stock Amid 40% Rally and Strong 2025 Results. What Should Investors Know?
events.body: Backed by brands like Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein, this global apparel leader reported a notable insider sale in recent filings.

events.title: PVH expects improved tariff mitigation results in 2026
events.body: The parent company of Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger plans to offset 60% of the financial impact of levies this year, doubling the percentage it achieved in 2025.
